scope: Manual source-policy assessment of every configured TypeSpec warning outside the retained-record join. Categories do not assert historical Swagger correspondence.

groups.reason: networking and vnetConfiguration remain object containers, but their nested fields permit Create/Read rather than Update. PATCH retains the opaque container while PUT flattens its children.
The custom PATCH systemData container is writable; its six SystemData members have no visibility restriction. Standard PUT resource systemData is Read-only.

PATCH kind is writable but the corresponding PUT source kind is Read-only. This is the established request-membership check, not whole-schema equality. Spec ownership must settle the intended discriminator contract.
PUT and PATCH use FleetProperties. Its description permits Create/Read and provisioningState permits only Read, leaving an opaque properties container only on the PATCH leaf side.
PUT edgeProfile is Read-only, but the custom PATCH edgeProfile/subscription/id chain is writable. A response-schema id does not establish PUT input membership.

bringYourOwnRoot is an object container on both sides; enabled is Create/Read and its other children are Read-only. The failure exists without version decorators, so this is not deferred merely because the service is versioned.
Standard PUT and PATCH share NetworkSettingsResourceProperties. subnetId/businessId are Create/Read and provisioningState is Read-only; flattening loses the PUT properties-container candidate.

The saved exact organization-route predicates report informaticaOrganizationProperties and existingResourceId, with no PUT input candidates. Swagger reports an outer properties wrapper instead; these two precise checks are outside the name-based retained-record join.

Eleven removed/renamed Deprecated declarations and the removed NetworkInterface description need historical names/availability. The latter PUT has a renamed descriptionDeprecated predecessor and a newer Read-only description; raw source matching is not historical reconstruction.
VmwareSite PUT uses SitesProperties with Read-only provisioningState. The separate VmwareSiteUpdateProperties declares it without that restriction.
usageThreshold20250901 has repeated removed/added/renamedFrom history, while its emitted historical wire name is usageThreshold. Defer reconstruction to #5875 rather than equate current source names.
SnapshotPatch is an empty model. Swagger counts its existing body parameter and misses the empty payload; TypeSpec's empty-body check is valid.

Custom PatchProxyResource.systemData is writable and inherited by application/service PATCH models. The standard PUT resource systemData is Read-only. Six distinct member warnings remain distinct despite sharing models.tsp:87:3.

ManagedDatabaseUpdate.properties uses ManagedDatabaseProperties, whose members are Create-only or Read-only. PATCH's opaque properties container is incorrectly compared against PUT's flattened child names.
containerAppsConfiguration remains an object container; all its children permit Create/Read rather than Update. The collector retains that PATCH wrapper but flattens PUT's children.
